run_update_failure_list_add: run the script to add new test failures to a protobuf conformance failure list file
run_update_failure_list_remove: run the script to remove test failures from a protobuf conformance failure list file
run_update_failure_list_add_and_remove: run the script to add and remove test failures in a single pass on the failure list
review_update_failure_list_logic: review the script that merges new failures into an existing list while preserving comments and sort order
test_update_failure_list_conflict: test the script to verify it raises an exception when the same test is in both add and remove lists
